comment: Parameter 0, the algorithm, and parameters 50 to 53, the per-operator fold types, are declared and read by process() but are never given ParamWidgets: the algorithm is set through AlgoDisplay at src/Four/Four.cpp:361 and the fold types through FoldTypeDisplay at src/Four/Four.cpp:435, both plain Widgets. They have no position in the census, so they carry no line and no tag; the two Menu lines and the two Note lines cover them instead. The panel SVG carries no lettering: every label is drawn in code by PanelLabels at src/Four/Four.cpp:552, which prints Four, Fine, VCA, V/Oct, XMod, Ext PM, Out, OP1 to OP4, and the row labels Freq, Level, Warp, Fold and FB. The Ext PM jack does two jobs at once — its voltage times the attenuator is clamped to 0..1 to give the depth (src/Four/engine.h:48), and the same voltage is the modulating signal (src/Four/engine.h:128) — which is why no negative field is written for it. Coarse in ratio mode snaps to 0.25, 0.5, 0.75 and then every half step from 1 to 31.5 (src/Four/dsp.h:361); in fixed mode it is continuous, exponential from 1Hz to 9999Hz (src/Four/dsp.h:371).
